rationale: The candidate reads as a coherent early-stage massing diagram: a compact rectilinear host with one substantial carved void and a legible roof/upper recess, visible consistently across the four views. It does not collapse into random fragments, and the open center gives it enough public threshold logic to support neighborhood_living. The main weakness is that the gesture is still somewhat generic and box-led rather than strongly sectional or site-responsive; the blue frontage edge is acknowledged only indirectly by the courtyard/edge recession, but not with a very emphatic access seam. Even so, it remains program-plausible and not incoherent across views, so it passes. The strongest next move would be to sharpen the access-side opening and deepen the court/public void rather than add more pieces.

reference_assessments.transferable_principle: Three-part low-rise composition with a central void and an upper connector preserves a clear public threshold while keeping the main mass legible.
